title: BanklerBot: AI Operating System
tagline: A personal knowledge system wired directly into an AI agent.
summary: Designing and building a personal AI operating system: an Obsidian knowledge vault integrated with Claude that unifies ideation, project tracking, task management, and long-term knowledge.

sections.heading: The idea
sections.body: BanklerBot connects one structured knowledge vault to Claude so that the same system handles capturing ideas, tracking projects and tasks, and keeping long-term knowledge.

sections.heading: What I have built so far
sections.body:
- Architected a PARA-based vault structure connected directly to Claude for natural-language search, summarization, and automation.
- Built a live task dashboard.
- Created a business ideation diligence pipeline that takes an idea from capture to a go or no-go decision.
- Put the whole system under Git version control for a complete change history.

sections.heading: Next steps
sections.body: Continue expanding the automations and the dashboard, and keep the system usable on its own without AI so that the knowledge stays durable.
